summary: Explore the latest trends and techniques in web development and design. Enroll in our comprehensive course to enhance your skills and stay ahead in the industry
lede: Web Development and Design Trends and Techniques teaches you to turn an annotated Figma concept into a tested front-end implementation. You will practise semantic HTML5, responsive CSS with Grid and Flexbox, JavaScript interactions, reusable components, and Git-based version histories. The course connects progressive enhancement, mobile-first design, accessibility, and performance testing through practical build exercises. You will evaluate keyboard and screen-reader access, review WCAG 2.2 conformance awareness, and use browser developer tools and Lighthouse to assess loading behaviour and Core Web Vitals improvement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who contribute to web development and design decisions, build front-end assets, or coordinate digital delivery. It suits foundation-level learners who want a structured entry point and practitioners with some exposure to HTML, CSS, or interface design who need a more disciplined workflow.
modules: Web Development Foundations and Delivery Trends
UX Research and Figma Interface Planning
Responsive CSS with Flexbox and Grid
Web Improvement Roadmaps and Stakeholder Reporting
prerequisites: No formal web development qualification is required. You should have basic digital workplace experience and an interest in websites, digital products, content, or interface design. You will write and edit introductory HTML, CSS, and JavaScript during exercises, but advanced programming is not required. Bring a laptop with a modern browser; familiarity with Figma or Git is useful but not essential.
